components.name: method
values: baseline | model that discards all perturbation information predicts control mean .

chemcpa | chemical compositional perturbation autoencoder an encoder-decoder architecture that encodes molecular structures of drugs via a molecule encoder g into latent perturbations uses a non-linear dosage scaler s and disentangles basal state from perturbation attributes via adversarial training gradient reversal . transfer learning is performed by pretraining on l1000 bulk rna data and fine-tuning on sci-plex3 single-cell data handling differing gene sets via a projection layer or shared gene subset.
cpa | compositional perturbation autoencoder as described by lotfollahi et al. 2021 used as baseline.
scgen | single-cell perturbation prediction model by lotfollahi et al. 2019 used as baseline.
